overview_description.description: Ghinwa is a music and karaoke mobile platform enabling amateur singers to record, share, and promote performances online. The application supports karaoke, cover songs, and self-broadcasting features that help users build audiences and showcase musical talent. Founded in 2015, Ghinwa focuses on empowering creative expression across the Middle East through interactive digital entertainment, social engagement, and music-driven community experiences.
